text: This solution, PNG Geohazards Website addresses natural catastrophe in Papua New Guinea between Department of Mineral Policy and Geohazards Management (DMPGM), Papua New Guinea National Weather Service (NWS), Water resource authorities, National Disaster Centre (NDC), Mineral Resources Authority (MRA), World Bank, Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR), AusAID (now DFAT), USAID/OFDA, and Geoscience Australia. The program was implemented in 2009 and focuses on collaboration, leveraging tech, and raising awareness.
